import numpy as np

# Get the position and bounding box extent of the 'brown spill'
spill_position, spill_quaternion, spill_bbox = get_object_pose('brown spill', return_bbox_extent=True)

# Calculate the min and max x and y bounds for wiping
x_min = spill_position[0] - spill_bbox[0] / 2
x_max = spill_position[0] + spill_bbox[0] / 2
y_min = spill_position[1] - spill_bbox[1] / 2
y_max = spill_position[1] + spill_bbox[1] / 2

# Set the wiping orientation (downward-facing)
wiping_orientation = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0])

# Move to the starting position for wiping (min x, min y)
start_position = np.array([x_min, y_min, 0.0])
goto_pose(start_position, wiping_orientation)

# Raster the spill area rather than moving straight to the far corner
for y in np.linspace(y_min, y_max, 10):
    for x in np.linspace(x_min, x_max, 10):
        goto_pose(np.array([x, y, 0.0]), wiping_orientation)
